name: Grapefruit Romulan Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Grapefruit Romulan hits with a rush of bright citrus, leading with sharp grapefruit zest that wakes up the palate. The finish pulls in Romulan’s earthy spice, giving the flavor a deeper edge that keeps it from being too sweet. Tangy, juicy, and unmistakably citrus forward, this hybrid puts grapefruit in the spotlight where it belongs.
